Depth 480 excludes FRU handles (fan +25 mm, PSU +38 mm per the HIG's space clearance note)."},"fan-bays":{"confidence":"photo-measured","note":"photo-measured 50.9 mm pitch; bay size follows the module face (50.7 x 40.0), which spans the hex grille (the HIG's 43.4 mm body) plus the ~8 mm flange carrying the airflow tag, captive screw and LED - see ufispace/fan-405637 provenance and the fan-faceplate-width gap."},"front-layout":{"confidence":"photo-measured","note":"photo-measured off the front product render (1676 px / 440 mm = 3.809 px/mm; height renders 44.1 mm against the 43.8 datasheet figure, 0.7 percent, so the render is orthographic and was used for positions). Eight silver ganged-cage blocks measured at x 74.6/120.5/165.9/211.3/257.0/ 302.4/347.9/393.5, regularised to a uniform 45.55 mm pitch from 74.6 (max deviation 0.35 mm); each silver shell 39.7 mm wide holding two 18.5 mm ganged apertures. Top apertures at y 11.5-19.8 and bottom at 26.6-35.2 in the render; modelled at 10.9 and 26.1 with the std 9.58 mm opening (centres within 0.2 mm of measured). The HIG's Figure 11 port overview (fig-0020) confirms the block structure and numbering but is guide art - it prints mock numerals on the cages where the real device silkscreens them below; the render wins."},"grounding":{"note":"HIG chapter 8 and Figures 22-23 - 'there are two locations on the case in which the grounding lug may be fixed'. One is the rear-left pair of M4 holes (Figure 23 draws the lug spanning both; the two rings at the rear left of both rear renders, drawn as decor with a ground symbol below); the other is on the left side near the rear under a yellow 'REMOVE LABEL FOR SYSTEM GROUNDING' sticker (Figure 22), drawn on the left view as the label. The lug itself (29 x 37.5 x 12.5 mm, ships loose in the accessory kit) is not seated by default."},"lane-leds":{"confidence":"photo-measured","note":"photo-measured - four round lamps per port above each cage column, top row for the top port and bottom row for the bottom port, 3.94 mm pitch, ~2.4 mm diameter (first quad's centres at 79.1-90.9 mm). Modelled as ufispace/lane-led-quad. The datasheet says only 'Link and Activity LEDs per port'; no table maps the four lamps, so they carry the off/on default - see the port-led-semantics gap."},"led-semantics":{"note":"HIG section 10 tables, transcribed onto the placements: front panel SYS / FAN / PSU0 / PSU1 / ID (the panel itself prints PS0/PS1/ID beside the lamps and that is what the silkscreen says); Management Port LED table = the two lamps on the OOB RJ45 (left green 1G, right amber 10M/100M); PSU FRU and Fan FRU tables live in the psu-751 and fan-405637 contracts."},"lifecycle":{"note":"searched 2026-08-28 ('UfiSpace S9110-32X end of life') - no announcement; the product page, EPSGlobal, STORDIS and reseller listings all carry it as current. Recorded as none-announced."},"mgmt-cluster":{"confidence":"photo-measured","note":"photo-measured; identities from HIG chapter 12 - the RJ45 marked with the network-tree symbol is OOB management ('Connect the OOB management cable by locating the RJ45 OOB port marked a symbol'), the RJ45 labelled IOIO is the console, the SFP+ under the orange MGMT label is the 1x 10G SFP+ management port, USB 3.0 Type-A between them. Orientation read at 8x zoom: the OOB jack sits keyway-up with its two lamps above (rotate 180 of the std part, which draws contacts-top/keyway-down), the console below it mirrors keyway-down (std default), the USB tongue is up (std default). The stacked jacks share one silver ganged shell, drawn as decor. std/rj45-ganged (12.7 x 11) is used because the two jacks sit on a sub-16 mm pitch inside a 32.3 mm shell; std/rj45's 16 mm bezel cannot."},"part-numbers":{"note":"no orderable chassis SKU appears in either document - the datasheet orders only FRUs (PSU-751-DESR/DISB/AESR/AISB, FAN-405637-HD/CD). A reseller listing (HyperScalers) names S9110-32X-2B7A, which is third-party and not recorded as a part number; see the orderable-part-numbers gap."},"port-numbering":{"note":"photo - the panel prints an up-triangle, the even number, the odd number and a down-triangle under each cage column ('\u25b20 1\u25bc' under the first). Column-major: even port on top, odd below, left to right 0-31. HIG Figure 11 prints the same assignment (block one reads 0/2 over 1/3). Port IDs are 0-31 (HIG port table: 'Port ID 0 ~ 31'), so index-origin is 0."},"power":{"confidence":"datasheet","note":"datasheet 'Typical power: 184 Watts (no transceiver)' - the vendor qualifies the envelope as bare of optics, hence power-envelope: bare. power-max-w 530.7 is the HIG's connecting-power step, 'The maximum system power consumption is 530.7 watts', stated identically for the DC and AC versions; the vendor does not qualify what population it assumes, and that sentence is recorded as the source. Inputs: AC 100-240 V 10 A, DC -36 to -75 V 28 A (datasheet; the HIG checklist adds 190-310 VDC 5 A for the AC unit, and the HIG power-up step narrows DC to -40 to -75 V for 5000 m)."},"qsfp-orientation":{"confidence":"estimated","note":"estimated - the two rows of a 2-high ganged QSFP block are modelled belly-to-belly with the BOTTOM row rotate 180, following the library's as7726-32x precedent for the same construction; the apertures are featureless black in every source at any zoom, so the mirror direction is not observable. The silver shell between and around the apertures is panel-side cage metal and is drawn as decor per the s9510-28dc precedent."},"rear-layout":{"confidence":"photo-measured","note":"photo-measured off the rear renders (1675 px / 440 mm = 3.807 px/mm, airflow variants identical in geometry): fan module seams at x 65.7/108.0, 116.6/158.9, 167.5/209.9 (50.9 mm bay pitch), PSU faces at 323.1-373.0 and 380.1-429.9 (49.9 mm measured against the 50.5 HIG face). 'FAN \u25c0N' is printed at the top of each fan's right flange column and 'PSU0\u25c0'/'PSU1\u25c0' read top-to-bottom on the chassis strips right of each PSU bay. The FAN marks fall inside the bay extents, so they are hidden when a module is seated - recorded rather than moved, because that is where the print is."},"sides":{"note":"left view from the angle render (screw row along the mid-height, a vent field at the front end) and HIG Figure 22 (the yellow grounding label near the rear); positions estimated - the angle render is oblique and passes no measurement gate. Right view is the left mirrored WITHOUT the grounding label, estimated from construction symmetry; no source shows it. AXIS CONVENTION: LEFT view x = 0 is the REAR; RIGHT view x = 0 is the FRONT (renderer-derived house convention). The screw rows are symmetric about mid-depth so the convention is not observable on them; the vent field and the grounding label are the asymmetric features and are placed per the convention."},"sources":{"confidence":"datasheet","note":"datasheet (S9110-32X 100G Data Center Switch, ufispace.com) and hardware installation guide, both docling-converted (s9110-32x-datasheet, s9110-32x-hig); four vendor product renders (angle, front and two rear gallery images). The two rear renders are the two airflow SKUs - blue handles (back-to-front) and red handles (front-to-back) - and are otherwise identical."},"top-view":{"confidence":"drawing","note":"drawing-fractions - HIG Figure 5's top view (fig-0012) passed no aspect gate as a whole page, so only fractions anchored to the 440 x 480 datasheet footprint were taken: four stadium stiffening grooves (two right-side at depth fractions 0.39/0.54, two nearly full-width at 0.66/0.81) and three screws near the rear edge. g.data-description: HIG Management Port LED table, left lamp - Off (no power), Solid Green (1G link-up), Blinking Green (1G TX/RX activity)
g.title: oob-led-left

g.data-description: HIG Management Port LED table, right lamp - Off (no power), Solid Amber (10M/100M link-up), Blinking Amber (10M/100M TX/RX activity)
g.title: oob-led-right

g.data-description: the lamp on the orange MGMT label. No HIG table covers it - the Management Port LED table is the RJ45 OOB jack (10M/100M/1G rows) - so it keeps the off/on default; see the port-led-semantics gap
g.title: led-mgmt

g.data-description: HIG SYS row - Off (no power), Solid Green (host CPU/BMC boot complete), Solid Amber (power is up but host CPU/BMC boot failed)
g.title: led-sys

g.data-description: HIG FAN row - Off (fans are not initialized), Solid Green (all fans work normal), Blinking Amber (fan fail - one or more fans need service)
g.title: led-fan

g.data-description: HIG PSU0 row - Off (no power), Solid Green (PSU0 working normal), Blinking Amber (PSU0 fail, needs service)
g.title: led-ps0

g.data-description: HIG PSU1 row - Off (no power), Solid Green (PSU1 working normal), Blinking Amber (PSU1 fail, needs service)
g.title: led-ps1

g.data-description: HIG ID row - Off (no power), Blinking Blue (beacon feature is enabled on the switch)
g.title: led-id

g.data-description: every indicator that belongs to a particular port, ordered by that port - the 32 lane quads, the OOB jack's two lamps and the MGMT label lamp
